title: DriftRemover: Hybrid Energy Optimizations for Anomaly Images Synthesis and Segmentation
mechanism: Generates anomaly image and mask together from a coarse mask plus category, taking the mask from synthesis attention maps, with two modules correcting drift between synthetic and real appearance.
adaptation: Treat jittered labels as coarse guides and take the output mask from what the generator drew; latent resolution limits it to inactive and blobby classes unless run at 2x.
min_experiment: PF + 500 generated inactive cells vs PF. Metric CV inactive IoU. Kill: < +0.02.
evidence: R: MVTec pixel AP +1.3, F1-max +1.8; Floor Dirt IoU +37.2%, F-measure +25.1%.
